paite: Huan TOUPA'N agensa bang in Sarah ava veh a, achiamsa bang in Sarah tung ah TOUPA'N ahihta hi.
heading: Isak Pianna
english: Yahweh visited Sarah as he had said, and Yahweh did to Sarah as he had spoken.

paite: Sarah agai a, Pathian in akiang a agen hun seh bang in, atek nung in Abraham tapa aneihsakta hi.
english: Sarah conceived, and bore Abraham a son in his old age, at the set time of which God had spoken to him.

paite: Abraham in Sarah in aneihsak atapa min Isak asa hi.
english: Abraham called his son who was born to him, whom Sarah bore to him, Isaac. Isaac means “He laughs.”

paite: Abraham in Pathian in akiang a thu apiak bang in atapa Isak ni giat achin in azek asumsak hi.
english: Abraham circumcised his son, Isaac, when he was eight days old, as God had commanded him.

paite: Atapa Isak apian lai in Abraham kum zakhat a upa ahita.
english: Abraham was one hundred years old when his son, Isaac, was born to him.

paite: Sarah in, "Pathian in hon nuisakta; aza kha peuhmah in hon nuihpih ding uh," achi hi.
english: Sarah said, “God has made me laugh. Everyone who hears will laugh with me.”

paite: Amah mah in, "Sarah in naungekte apom ding, chih kua'n ahia Abraham kiang a gen thei ding? Atek nung in tapa ka neihsakta,” achi hi.
english: She said, “Who would have said to Abraham, that Sarah would nurse children? For I have borne him a son in his old age.”

paite: Naungek ahong khanglian a, nawinek atawpsakta uh. Isak nawinek atawpsak ni un, Abraham in ankuang thupitak alui hi.
english: The child grew, and was weaned. Abraham made a great feast on the day that Isaac was weaned.

paite: Aigupta mi Hagar tapa, Abraham a ding a aneihsak pen in Isak asimmohbawl lai Sarah in amu hi.
heading: Hagar Leh Ishmael Sawlkhiakna
english: Sarah saw the son of Hagar the Egyptian, whom she had borne to Abraham, mocking.

paite: Huaiziak in Abraham kiang ah, "Hiai sikhanu leh atapa delhkhia in. Hiai sikhanu tapa in ka tapa Isak gou aluahpih thei kei ding,” achi hi.
english: Therefore she said to Abraham, “Cast out this handmaid and her son! For the son of this handmaid will not be heir with my son, Isaac.”

paite: Hiai thu atapa mah toh kisai ahih ziak in Abraham ngaih in thil hoih loutak ahi.
english: The thing was very grievous in Abraham’s sight on account of his son.

paite: Himahleh Pathian in Abraham kiang ah, "Naupang tungtang thu leh na sikhanu tungtang thu na ngaih in thil hoih lou hi kei hen. Sarah in na kiang a thu agen tengteng zui in, Isak ah na suante kisim ding chih ahi ngal a,
english: God said to Abraham, “Don’t let it be grievous in your sight because of the boy, and because of your handmaid. In all that Sarah says to you, listen to her voice. For from Isaac will your seed be called.

paite: Sikhanu tapa ah leng, na suan ahih ziak in, nam chih tham ngial ka bawl ding," achi hi.
english: I will also make a nation of the son of the handmaid, because he is your seed.”

paite: Beltak in Abraham athou a, tanghou leh tuithawl, tui a dim ala a, Hagar kiang a pia in, aliangkou ah asuan a, naupang toh asawlkhia hi. Apai a, Beer-sheba gamdai ah avakvakta hi.
english: Abraham rose up early in the morning, and took bread and a bottle of water, and gave it to Hagar, putting it on her shoulder; and gave her the child, and sent her away. She departed, and wandered in the wilderness of Beersheba.

paite: Tuithawl a tui ahong beitak in, sawlbawk lim nuai khat ah naupang akoihta mai hi.
english: The water in the bottle was spent, and she cast the child under one of the shrubs.

paite: "Naupang si ding ka en ngam kei," achih ziak in gamla kuam, thal kap phakna ding ah, ava pai a, amazawn a tu in ngaihtak in akapta hi.
english: She went and sat down opposite him, a good way off, about a bow shot away. For she said, “Don’t let me see the death of the child.” She sat over against him, and lifted up her voice, and wept.

paite: Pathian in naupang aw aza a; Pathian angel in van a kipan Hagar asam a, akiang ah, "Bangchi na hia, Hagar? Lau ke'n, a-omna a naupang aw Pathian in aza hi.
english: God heard the voice of the boy. The angel of God called to Hagar out of the sky, and said to her, “What ails you, Hagar? Don’t be afraid. For God has heard the voice of the boy where he is.

paite: Thou inla, naupang phong in, na khut in len in, amah nam thupitak a bawl ding ka hi," achi hi.
english: Get up, lift up the boy, and hold him in your hand. For I will make him a great nation.”

paite: Pathian in amit ahihvaksak a, huan tuileh amuta hi. Huai ah ava pai a, tuithawl dim in tui adim a, naupang adawnsak hi.
english: God opened her eyes, and she saw a well of water. She went, filled the bottle with water, and gave the boy drink.

paite: Naupang kiang ah Pathian a-om a, ahong khanglian a; gamdai ah ateng zel a, thalkapmi ahong hita hi.
english: God was with the boy, and he grew. He lived in the wilderness, and became, as he grew up, an archer.

paite: Paran gamdai dai ah ateng a; Aigupta gam a kipan zi aguan hi.
english: He lived in the wilderness of Paran. His mother took a wife for him out of the land of Egypt.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, huai lai in Abimelek leh asepaih pawl a heutu Phikol in Abraham kiang ah, "Na thilhih peuh ah na kiang ah Pathian a-om.
heading: Abraham Leh Abimelek Kithukimna
english: It happened at that time, that Abimelech and Phicol the captain of his army spoke to Abraham, saying, “God is with you in all that you do.

paite: Tu in hiai ah Pathian min lou inla, kei leh ka tapa leh ka tapa' tapa leng khem lou in, ka hon hehpih khit tak sa bang in kei leh na tenna gam hehpih thuk sam ding in ka kiang ah kichiam in," achi hi.
english: Now, therefore, swear to me here by God that you will not deal falsely with me, nor with my son, nor with my son’s son. But according to the kindness that I have done to you, you shall do to me, and to the land in which you have lived as a foreigner.”

paite: Abraham in, “Ka kichiam ding," achi hi.
english: Abraham said, “I will swear.”

paite: Abimelek sikhate'n tuileh asuhsak ziak un Abraham in Abimelek asal hi.
english: Abraham complained to Abimelech because of a water well, which Abimelech’s servants had violently taken away.

paite: Abimelek in, “Hiai thilhih pen kua ahia, ka thei himhim kei. Nang lah na hon hilh ngal kei a, tuni ngal lou in ka za kha himhim kei," achi hi.
english: Abimelech said, “I don’t know who has done this thing. You didn’t tell me, neither did I hear of it, until today.”

paite: Abraham in belamte leh bawngtalte api a, Abimelek kiang ah apia a; anih un thu akhungta uhi.
english: Abraham took sheep and cattle, and gave them to Abimelech. Those two made a covenant.

paite: Abraham in abelamhon lak a belamnou anu sagih akoihtuam hi.
english: Abraham set seven ewe lambs of the flock by themselves.

paite: Abimelek in Abraham kiang ah, "Belamnou anu sagih atuam a na koih bang na chihna ahia?” achi hi.
english: Abimelech said to Abraham, “What do these seven ewe lambs which you have set by themselves mean?”

paite: Ama'n, "Hiai tuileh keimah leh ahi, chih na hon theihpihna ding in hiai belamnou anu sagih ka khut a kipan na lak ding ahi," achi hi.
english: He said, “You shall take these seven ewe lambs from my hand, that it may be a witness to me, that I have dug this well.”

paite: Huaiziak in huai mun Beer-sheba asa hi; huai a anih ua akichiam ziak un.
english: Therefore he called that place Beersheba, Beersheba can mean “well of the oath” or “well of seven.” because they both swore there.

paite: Beer-sheba ah thu akhungta uh. Abimelek athou a, asepaih pawl heutu Philok toh Philistiate gam ah apai nawnta uhi.
english: So they made a covenant at Beersheba. Abimelech rose up with Phicol, the captain of his army, and they returned into the land of the Philistines.

paite: Abraham in Beer-sheba ah meilah sing asuan a, huai ah TOUPA, Tangtawn Pathian min alou hi.
english: Abraham planted a tamarisk tree in Beersheba, and called there on the name of Yahweh, the Everlasting God.

paite: Philistiate gam ah Abraham sawtpi ataam hi.
english: Abraham lived as a foreigner in the land of the Philistines many days.
